boundaryReview.176: Effective/total stress separated; thick-ring and strip assumptions explicit.
boundaryReview.177: Hoisting and cutting capacities share in-situ basis only in the bottleneck comparison.
boundaryReview.178: Projection, wedge geometry and joint pressure remain explicit; area ratio is not a strength ratio.
boundaryReview.179: Thermal diffusion and outage reserve are scales, not permits. Thaw strain requires one-dimensional boundary.
boundaryReview.180: Slurry-water pressure difference is not total stability; high gradient is not an allowable gradient.
boundaryReview.181: Overlap and nominal geometry do not prove watertightness; independent errors are explicitly assumed.
boundaryReview.182: Euler/Rankine idealizations, dry-side water pressure and common datum are explicit.
boundaryReview.183: Thermal restraint, real contact and unloading stiffness boundaries are specified.
boundaryReview.184: Stable-zone geometry is distinguished from bond capacity; group efficiency is assumed.
boundaryReview.185: Steel-only stress, unsupported Euler segment, equal-displacement groups and connection moment couples are explicit.
boundaryReview.186: Dry-binder mass balance, unequal ground/column stress and dimensionless hydraulic gradient are separated; pressure head requires an added length.
boundaryReview.187: Equal-strain stiffness is distinguished from constrained modulus; rotations per metre are not mixing energy or a quality guarantee.
boundaryReview.188: Gaussian trough geometry is not a grout prescription; volume efficiency and gain are explicitly local synthetic assumptions; curvature excludes discrete joints.
boundaryReview.189: Isotropic undrained pore pressure is not a general shear rule; ideal grout geometry is not a treatment radius; surveyed heave and cavity fill are not all retained grout. Volume strain and vertical layer strain are distinguished.
boundaryReview.190: Diffusion length scaling explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed; actual drain spacing changes geometric ratio, smear and well resistance. Horizontal diffusion coefficient units, equivalent perimeter diameter, normally consolidated one-dimensional settlement and matched-gradient clogging comparison are explicit.
boundaryReview.191: Vacuum observations share pressure/state reference; total stress and combined net pore-pressure increments are separated.
boundaryReview.192: Empirical depth coefficient units, energy loss and nonuniform delivery are stated.
boundaryReview.193: Darcy applicability, toe/head load difference and unit-cell versus global effects are stated.
boundaryReview.194: Compatible CRR/CSR, one-dimensional strain and dragload accounting are stated.
boundaryReview.195: Wave direction, strain allocation, material curves and joint movement components are separated.
boundaryReview.196: Units 6 and 9 were corrected after review: underside uplift at fixed upper pressure is distinguished explicitly from constant net buoyancy of a fully submerged sealed fixed-volume box.
boundaryReview.197: Projection and friction exclude separate anchor effects; geometric criteria do not prove stability.
boundaryReview.198: Two-way timing, calibrated velocity, attenuation path and confirmation-versus-detection fractions are explicit.
boundaryReview.199: Ideal free-ring buckling, short/long-term modulus and full uniform Manning flow boundaries explicit.
boundaryReview.200: IR drop versus polarization and electrochemical efficiency versus material utilization are separated.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設排水流量Q=0.0002m³/s、整段水力導通係數C=0.0001m²/s，Δh=Q/C=2m；C不是土壤滲透係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For Q=0.0002m³/s and whole-drain hydraulic conductance C=0.0001m²/s, Δh=Q/C=2m. Conductance is not soil hydraulic conductivity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設該土點Δσ=40kPa、實測淨Δu=−50kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=90kPa；此孔壓已包含當時各效應。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a soil point with Δσ=40kPa and measured net Δu=−50kPa, Δσ′=90kPa. The pressure change already includes the combined effects at that time.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設僅主要壓密沉陷S=0.24m、預測最終S∞=0.30m，U=S/S∞=0.80；不是任一沉陷讀值都可代入。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For primary-consolidation settlement S=0.24m and predicted final S∞=0.30m, U=0.80. Not every observed settlement component is suitable for this ratio.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設孔壓由−60kPa於3h回到0kPa，平均恢復率=[0−(−60)]/3=20kPa/h；零點為同一參考狀態。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If pressure recovers from−60kPa to0kPa in3h, the mean rate is20kPa/h, using a common pressure reference.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水平相對位移5mm、觀測基距10m，εh=0.005/10=0.0005，即0.05%；符號與方向須另行記錄。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative horizontal movement5mm over10m, εh=0.005/10=0.0005, or0.05%. Record sign and direction separately.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設卸載幅值Δσ′=30kPa、層厚H=8m、重壓模數M=12000kPa，回彈S=Δσ′H/M=0.020m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For unloading magnitude Δσ′=30kPa, layer H=8m and reloading modulus M=12000kPa, rebound S=Δσ′H/M=0.020m.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.

教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設超額孔壓Δu=60kPa、初始有效垂直應力σ′v0=80kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.75；分母為初始有效應力而非總應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For excess Δu=60kPa and initial effective vertical stress σ′v0=80kPa, ru=0.75. The denominator is initial effective stress, not total stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓錐坑半徑r=1.5m、深h=0.6m，V=πr²h/3=1.414m³，約1.41m³；不代表相同體積的密實量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an ideal conical crater with r=1.5m and h=0.6m, V=πr²h/3=1.414m³, about1.41m³, not the same volume of densification.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa. Toe load need not equal the column-head load.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設局部排水水頭增加Δh=2m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×2=19.62kPa，約19.6kPa；未改變總應力時有效應力同量下降。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa. Effective stress falls by the same amount if total stress is unchanged.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN. Do not also credit positive friction over that segment.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%. The remaining100m² is not automatically acceptable because the overall fraction is high.

教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設轉角θ=0.002rad、距旋轉軸R=4m，邊緣位移Δedge≈θR=0.008m即8mm；正負端方向相反。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For θ=0.002rad and distance R=4m from the rotation axis, Δedge≈θR=0.008m, or8mm, with opposite signs on opposite edges.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. This is not a formula predicting fault displacement.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設外側水頭增加Δh=8m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；此為增加值而非總設計水壓。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an external head increase Δh=8m, Δu=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. This is added pressure, not total design pressure.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight.

教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN. An unverified interface must not automatically receive this resistance.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure. A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments.

教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m. Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For one compatible scenario with W=7000kN, additional R=1000kN and U=7500kN, the unfactored margin W+R−U=500kN. A positive margin alone is not full code compliance.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.

教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces.

教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h. This is not instantaneous velocity and cannot directly predict time to failure.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取v=0.1m/ns、校正後雙程t=30ns，z=vt/2=1.5m；t已扣除儀器與空氣路徑偏移，並假設垂直反射。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=0.1m/ns and corrected two-way t=30ns, z=vt/2=1.5m. Time already excludes instrument and air-path offsets, with vertical reflection assumed.

教學假設，非現場設定值：均質地盤點散射模型t(x)=2√(z²+x²)/v；取z=1m、x=1m、v=0.1m/ns，t=28.28ns，約28.3ns。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a homogeneous point-scatterer model t(x)=2√(z²+x²)/v, use z=1m, x=1m and v=0.1m/ns to obtain t=28.28ns, about28.3ns.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m. This does not establish an actual resolution of0.20m.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設振幅衰減係數α=2m⁻¹、單程z=1m，A/A0=e^(−αz)=e^(−2)=0.135；雙程同深度僅此項為e^(−4)=0.0183。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amplitude attenuation coefficient α=2m⁻¹ and one-way z=1m, A/A0=e^(−αz)=0.135. The corresponding round-trip factor alone is e^(−4)=0.0183.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取兩側εr1=4、εr2=9，以對比指標C=(√εr2−√εr1)/(√εr2+√εr1)=(3−2)/(3+2)=0.20；符號須依電場定義校核。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For εr1=4 and εr2=9, contrast index C=(√εr2−√εr1)/(√εr2+√εr1)=(3−2)/(3+2)=0.20. Check sign against the chosen electric-field convention.

教學假設，非現場設定值：已知路段實長10.0m，里程輪顯示10.2m，相對誤差=(10.2−10.0)/10.0=2%；若條件不變，顯示距離需乘10/10.2校正。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a true10.0m line measured as10.2m, relative error=(10.2−10.0)/10.0=2%. Under unchanged conditions, displayed distance requires a10/10.2 correction factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：在t固定且小變動近似下，Δz/z=Δv/v；取v=0.10m/ns、Δv=0.01m/ns，深度相對變動為10%。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed t and a small-change approximation, Δz/z=Δv/v. For v=0.10m/ns and Δv=0.01m/ns, the relative depth variation is10%.

教學假設，非現場設定值：採一階獨立誤差傳遞，z=vt/2，取t=30ns、v=0.10m/ns、σv=0.01m/ns、σt=1ns且獨立，σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m.

教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設24個候選目標中18個得到獨立確認，確認比例18/24=75%；其餘6個仍未解，不能解讀成75%的整體探測率。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If18 of24 candidate targets have independent confirmation, the confirmation fraction is75%. Six remain unresolved; this is not a75% detection rate for all utilities.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.

教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded.

教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor.

教學假設，非現場設定值：若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同方向雜散電流I=0.10A持續t=3600s，Q=It=360C；正負交替需分方向積分，不可只用帶符號淨值推估局部腐蝕。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For same-direction stray current I=0.10A over t=3600s, Q=It=360C. Alternating directions need separate integration; signed net charge alone cannot estimate local corrosion.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設旁路兩端V=1V、R=5Ω，Ibypass=V/R=0.20A；此電流未必到達需要保護的裸露金屬，不可全部計作有效保護。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For V=1V across bypass R=5Ω, Ibypass=V/R=0.20A. It may not reach exposed metal needing protection and cannot all be credited as effective current.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較工況需求由0.20A升到0.60A，比值Inew/Iold=3；此三倍僅表示需求變化，不表示防蝕能力或安全程度提高三倍。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If comparable demand rises from0.20A to0.60A, Inew/Iold=3. This describes demand, not a tripling of protection effectiveness or safety.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設非閏年8760h內I=0.20A恆定，Qyear=I×8760h=1752Ah；這是一年累積電量，若稱年度率才寫1752Ah/year。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For constant I=0.20A over a nonleap year of8760h, Qyear=1752Ah. This is accumulated annual charge;1752Ah/year denotes an annual rate instead.
